description: List domains in the authenticated EnCirca account with recorded expiration dates within a configurable number of days. This is an account-scoped view, not a public ownership lookup or proof of renewal eligibility, auto-renewal configuration, payment status, or current renewal price.

only_expired.description: Return only expired domains, regardless of within_days.

partner_id.description: ESB partner id. Optional if ENCIRCA_MCP_DEFAULT_PARTNER_ID is set.

name: list_expiring_domains
